Today's selection covers 61 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 37 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Family of child injured in Canada school shooting sues OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: You Could Be Next
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
